final_message:
I implemented `redact` in `labkit/safety/redact.py`, and all 3 tests in `tests.test_s4_redact` pass.

- **Emails:** a regex replaces email addresses with `[EMAIL]`.
- **Phones:** a second regex replaces 10-digit numbers (3-3-4 groups) with `[PHONE]`. It allows an optional `+1`, parentheses around the area code, and spaces, dots or dashes between the parts. It won't match digits that sit inside a longer run of digits.

My first version of the phone pattern swallowed the space before the number, so `"call 555-123-4567 now"` became `"call[PHONE] now"`. I tightened the pattern so separators are only allowed between the parts of the number, and the tests then passed.

I only ran the provided tests, so edge cases beyond them, such as a phone number glued to letters, aren't checked.
